```{r}
source("./Project_FY4B/main_pkgs.R")

options(datatable.print.nrow = 21)
f_full = "./Project_FY4B/data/filelist_full_202206-202412.txt"

detect_date <- function(files) {
  data.table(file = files) %>% mutate(
    date_beg = str_extract(file, "\\d{14}(?=_\\d{14})") %>% as_datetime(),
    date_end = str_extract(file, "(?<=\\d{14}_)\\d{14}") %>% as_datetime(),
    dhour = cal_hours(date_end, date_beg), 
    .before = file
  )
}
```

## 1 full
```{r}
dates_all <- seq(make_datetime(2022, 6), make_datetime(2024, 12, 31, 23), by = "hour")
df_full = fread(f_full)$file %>% detect_date()
```

## move files

```{r}
.tmp = foreach(YEAR = 2025, i = icount()) %do% {
    runningId(i)

    files = dat[year(date_beg) == YEAR, file]
    outdir = sprintf("Z:/China/Prcp_Hourly_FY4B_202206-now/%d", YEAR)
    mkdir(outdir)
    file_mv(files, outdir)
}
```


## 3 检查漏下文件
```{r}
dat = readLines("filelist.txt") %>% detect_date()
df = readLines("filelist.txt") %>% basename() %>% unique() %>% detect_date()
setkeyv(df, c("date_beg", "date_end"))
```



```{r}
dates1 = df[dhour == 1, date_beg] # 14538
dates2 = df[dhour == 0.25, .(date_beg)] %>% 
    .[, .N, .(date_beg = round_date(date_beg, "hour"))] %>% 
    .[N == 4, date_beg]

dates = c(dates1, dates2) %>% unique()
dates_miss = setdiff(dates_all, dates) # 4408

lst = split(dates_miss, year(dates_miss)) %>% map(\(date) data.table(date))
write_list2xlsx(lst, "FY4B_miss.xlsx")

data.table(date = dates_miss) %>% 
    .[, .N, .(date = round_date(date, "month"))]

```

writeLines(urls, "./Project_FY4B/data/urls.txt")
